text: TRIGGERED #4213 [SEV1] sms-gateway: anomalous inbound reply rate on workflow st-aldric-er-discharge — 'wrong number' / 'who is this' replies spiking above threshold. Assigned: on-call (tbrzezinski).
support just pinged me too, patients are replying that the message isnt for them
ok. its the morning batch. the discharge batch for St. Aldric went out with the recipient mapping shifted off by one. 312 messages.
pausing the sender now. nothing else goes out on st aldric workflows until the mapping is fixed
pause everything on that tenant, not just discharge. how did the mapping shift?
the 06:00 csv import dropped a header row, so every recipient below it shifted one row up. patient A got patient B's discharge message
how many actually delivered vs bounced?
carrier report pending, a bunch will hard-fail on landlines
compliance hat on: those messages carry patient first names + the discharge instruction text in the body right? so PHI went to the wrong recipients
yes. first name, facility, and the discharge instructions
do we need to tell St. Aldric legal?
mapping fix is up in PR #1841, added a header checksum so the import fails loud instead of silently shifting rows
merged + deployed. logged as INC-2026-007 in the incident sheet
lets just fix the mapping and move on, we'll write it up later
fix is live, resuming the st aldric queues
resolving the pager. what a day
